reviews.title: Bad accessibility
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for this app so I could organize schedules. However it has basically zero accessibility features that I could find. 

My husband is legally blind and needs dark mode to be able to see a screen. They don’t have that as an option. Almost all of the themes they do have are behind a paywall.

reviews.title: Appointments Are Dropping off
reviews.text:
After noticing appointments are not staying on the app, I asked the Cozi support if there was a way to determine if someone is deleting the appointments or if they are falling off. I was told there isn’t a way to track that information. I have had way too many fall off of the calendar this year. Even though I confirm them with staff after entering them into the calendar. I am choosing not to renew my gold account at this point. No issues until 2026.

Cozi’s response:
Cozi responded to your review of Cozi Family Organizer		
Cozi Family Organizer
Cozi
"Hi, We're sorry for any issues or concerns! Cozi doesn't offer a calendar tracking feature that would enable you to identify who in your account made changes to the calendar or when, and we've reiterated your request that we add this feature in the future. For now, though, any events that you add to the calendar with an online connection will remain in the calendar unless you or someone else in the account manually deletes them. There's no known reason for events that have been saved with an online connection to be deleted other than if someone in the account deletes them. We apologize again for any issues you're having, and if we can help further with this or with anything else please reach us again at cozi.com/contact-us so we can try to help further. Thanks, Cozi"

I confirm my appointments are saved in the app before I leave the office. It has nothing to do with an online connection as these appointments show in the app befor

reviews.title: Too many changes
reviews.text: It seems like all the update are pushing more AI into this app and every time I figure it out it changes again.  Also it doesn't link with alot of other apps like Alexa for my calendar reminders. I've been using Cozi for a decade but not sure I'll renew next year.  If I have to input everything twice I might as well just use Google Calendar ever if I don't like it nearly as much.

reviews.title: Disappointing

It has been a complete disaster for my family. I can’t get anyone else to use it because it’s not intuitive and it hasn’t made things more simple. But it has cost me.

reviews.title: Requires $80/yr subscription to use
reviews.text:
I was really disappointed with this app. Even after paying for the Gold subscription at $30/yr, most features were still locked and only available at the $80/yr subscription. Crucially, the gold package does not allow for
Importing from an existing calendar. So it was basically useless. It does offer a chores feature. But there is only one view - kids cannot view just their own chores.

reviews.title: Looks great on apple, terrible on pixel
reviews.text: This app looks and works completely different based on if you are using an apple or pixel device. The Apple version allows you to do all the things I would expect to be able to do for an app I paid for, but when I saw what it looks like on a Pixel, I’m just so surprised. The calendar doesn’t allow you to view individual days like the apple version, there are no color markers, and overall I just can’t believe I paid for it to look terrible on 1 of the whole 2 phones I needed it for. Will definitely be looking into other calendar apps in the future.

reviews.title: Don’t rely on Cozi!
reviews.text: I’m sick and tired of the app randomly deleting my appointments. There is no rhyme or reason to it. So I can’t even pinpoint the issue. Yes I’ve updated the app, yes I’ve refreshed the app, closed it and opened it again, yes I pay for the Gold service. Cozi fails at literally the one thing it is meant to do!!! I can’t rely on it to accurately represent family appointments - it has caused arguments and missed appointments. Not cool at all.

reviews.title: Can’t change to start weeks on a Monday
reviews.text: Everything else is nice but this is a major downfall and you cannot reach out to any support for help. A quick search show many others have the same issue. Minor thing but a major deal breaker. If they could allow changing weeks to start on Mondays I would use it but until then I am deleting and finding another app. I don’t want to have to use workarounds/google calendar to fix the issue, I want the app to work
